title: 封印酒馆 · 序幕：第一盏灯
description: 穿越异界 · 初遇巡防骑士 · 卡牌支援战斗 · 一起修复驿站
source: 原创奇幻剧情及四道分段听力理解题，非考试原文。
audioLabel: 离线英文角色配音 · Brian / Sonia / Michelle / Christopher / Guy

questions.prompt: Why does Iserya welcome Lu Chuan?
options: She needs his help to protect another world.
She wants him to finish his exam.
She wants him to return to his dormitory.
She is asking him to repair her computer.
questions.explanation: 女神说明，她需要陆川帮助守护另一个世界。

questions.prompt: What must Lu Chuan do to strengthen the seal?
options: Buy a legendary sword and leave the town.
Close the tavern to keep everyone away.
Bring the crystal back to his dormitory.
Welcome guests and recover crystal fragments.
questions.explanation: 女神说明：客人相聚提供能量，地下城碎片修复晶石结构。经营和探索缺一不可。

lines.speaker: 伊瑟雅
lines.text: Welcome, Lu Chuan. I am Iserya. I need your help to protect another world.
lines.translation: 欢迎你，陆川。我是伊瑟雅。我需要你帮助守护另一个世界。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: A goddess? Then I suppose this is more serious than falling asleep at my desk.
lines.translation: 女神？看来这比趴在桌上睡着严重多了。

lines.speaker: 伊瑟雅
lines.text: A demon king is sealed beneath a border town. The seal is weakening.
lines.translation: 一位魔王被封印在边境小镇地下。如今，封印正在衰弱。

lines.speaker: 伊瑟雅
lines.text: He cannot escape yet, but his soldiers can cross the cracks and attack our people.
lines.translation: 他还无法脱身，但他的士兵已经能穿过裂隙，袭击这里的人们。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: So you need a hero with a legendary sword?
lines.translation: 所以，你需要一位拿着传说之剑的勇者？

lines.speaker: 伊瑟雅
lines.text: Actually, I need someone who can run a tavern. Its crystal holds the surface seal together.
lines.translation: 其实，我需要一个能经营酒馆的人。那里的晶石维系着地面封印。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Saving the world now requires experience in hospitality? That was not in my study plan.
lines.translation: 现在拯救世界还要求餐饮经验？我的复习计划可没这项。

lines.speaker: 伊瑟雅
lines.text: Repair the tavern, welcome guests, and recover crystal fragments from the dungeon below.
lines.translation: 修好酒馆，迎接客人，再到下面的地下城找回晶石碎片。

lines.speaker: 伊瑟雅
lines.text: Their shared warmth will power the crystal. The fragments will repair its broken structure.
lines.translation: 人们相聚的温暖会为晶石供能，碎片则能修复它破损的结构。

lines.speaker: 言契系统
lines.text: Language contract established. Answer vocabulary questions to cast spells in battle.
lines.translation: 语言契约已建立，回答词汇题，可以施放法术进行战斗。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: I understand the instructions. I am no good with a sword, but I can try learning vocabulary.
lines.translation: 指令我看懂了。用剑我不在行，不过，背单词我可以试试。

lines.speaker: 伊瑟雅
lines.text: Once the seal is stable, I can open a safe path home. Until then, you will have help.
lines.translation: 等封印稳定下来，我就能打开安全的归途。在那之前，你也会有同伴。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The white light fades. Lu Chuan finds himself inside a ruined waystation. Rain falls through the broken roof.
lines.translation: 白光散去，陆川发现自己站在一座破损的驿站里。雨水穿过残破的屋顶。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Where am I? This place looks abandoned.
lines.translation: 这是哪里？这里看起来已经荒废了……

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: A beast crouches in the middle of the hall, gnawing on animal bones. Purple mushrooms cover its back.
lines.translation: 大厅中央，一头怪物正伏在地上啃食动物骨头。紫色的蘑菇爬满了它的背。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Do not move. Please do not notice me.
lines.translation: 不能动……千万别发现我。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Lu Chuan holds his breath. Beyond the doorway, hurried footsteps draw closer through the rain.
lines.translation: 陆川屏住呼吸，一动也不敢动。门外，急促的脚步声穿过雨幕，越来越近。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Stay where you are. Keep your voice down.
lines.translation: 站在那里别动，压低声音。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: A red-haired knight steps through the doorway, sword drawn. She places herself between Lu Chuan and the beast.
lines.translation: 一位红发骑士持剑踏进门内，挡在陆川与怪物之间。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Who are you? Did you come for that creature?
lines.translation: 你是谁？你是来找那只怪物的吗？

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: I am Aelia, a knight of the border patrol. I came to deal with the beast that destroyed this waystation.
lines.translation: 我叫艾莉娅，是边境巡防骑士。我来处理这头破坏驿站的怪物。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: I just appeared here. I have no idea what is happening.
lines.translation: 我刚刚突然出现在这里，根本不知道发生了什么。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: We can talk later. Stay behind me, and watch its claws.
lines.translation: 其他事之后再说。站在我身后，小心它的爪子。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The beast drops the bone and raises its head. A low growl breaks the silence. Aelia lifts her shield.
lines.translation: 怪物丢下骨头，抬起头，低沉的咆哮打破了沉寂。艾莉娅举起盾牌。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Prepare for battle.
lines.translation: 准备战斗吧。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: It is over. Are you hurt?
lines.translation: 结束了……你没受伤吧？

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: No. I only just noticed that my legs are still shaking.
lines.translation: 没有。只是现在才发现，我的腿一直在抖。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Thank you. Your barrier stopped its claws from reaching me.
lines.translation: 谢谢你。刚才那道屏障替我挡住了它的爪子。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: You stood in front of me. I could not just watch.
lines.translation: 你挡在我前面，我总不能只站着看。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: This roof will not keep you dry. You helped me with the beast. Let me help you repair the waystation.
lines.translation: 这里已经不能遮雨了。你帮我解决了魔物，我也帮你把驿站修起来。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: They recover usable boards and support the damaged beam. The first patch keeps the rain away.
lines.translation: 他们找出还能用的木板，撑住受损的横梁。第一块补板挡住了头顶的雨。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Hold this side. I will secure it. Keep clear of the beam.
lines.translation: 扶住这一边。我来固定，别站到横梁下面。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: You know how to repair a roof, too?
lines.translation: 你连修屋顶都会？

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: On border patrol, finding a place to sleep can be harder than finding an enemy.
lines.translation: 边境巡防时，找到能睡的屋子比找到敌人还难。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Then I will pass you the boards. I can start by being a useful helper.
lines.translation: 那我负责递木板。今天先从合格的帮手做起。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Rain no longer reaches the hall. They clear the rubble and bring old rugs, lamps, and potted plants out of storage.
lines.translation: 雨终于不再落进大厅。两人清走碎石，把储藏室里的旧地毯、灯具和盆栽搬了出来。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: I thought I would have to figure everything out alone after arriving here.
lines.translation: 我本来以为，来到这里之后，所有事都得自己想办法。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: On the border, no one can manage alone forever.
lines.translation: 在边境，没人能一直靠自己撑下去。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: When we can welcome guests, I want travelers to have somewhere to rest.
lines.translation: 等这里能接待客人，我想让路过的人都能有个歇脚的地方。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Then let us light the hearth. A place to return to should be warm.
lines.translation: 那就先把炉火点起来。归处应该是暖的。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: By the time they secure the final board, morning has arrived. Sunlight fills the waystation, and the floor is dry at last.
lines.translation: 翌日清晨。最后一块木板固定时，天已亮了。晨光照进驿站，昨夜的积水终于退去。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: We actually fixed it. Last night, I thought it might collapse.
lines.translation: 真修好了……昨晚这里还像随时会塌。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: The roof and stairs are secure. We can use the hall now and improve the rest gradually.
lines.translation: 屋顶和楼梯已经稳住，能先使用了。剩下的地方可以慢慢整理。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Breakfast is on me. You are our first guest.
lines.translation: 第一份早餐我请。你可是这里的第一位客人。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: A guest? After working all night, surely I count as your helper.
lines.translation: 客人？我干了一整夜的活，至少该算你的帮手吧。

ending: 驿站基础修复完成。陆川与艾莉娅一起迎来天亮，经营基础已解锁。第一章“今天开始营业”后续开放。
